admission.justification: A future recovery must not turn failed reads into current anchors or rebind stale content. Moved, stale, unreadable and anchorless test assertions directly distinguish these states and verify no input mutation.

applicability: Official-code currentness of every selected carryover sidecar anchor.
conditions: Plan observes realizes, proves and code/test-reference anchors using the selected official code tree.

exclusions: Source HEAD and ambient worktree bytes cannot substitute for the selected official tree.

Explicitly reviewed noncurrent anchors may be retained unchanged for the curator/worklist/validator; review is not mechanical reanchoring or validator waiver.
Currentness does not enlarge the recorded-blob reader guarantees INV-RANN4DC0/INV-1RWT3JRR.

evidence: Frozen generation3 source inspection; no new execution or acceptance.

statement: Every candidate anchor is observed at official code; moved identical content is re-recorded, and stale or unverifiable anchors require review.
